reviewContext.userProblem: There are two parts. PART A: the working tree holds uncommitted, already-verified work from sessions 708 and 710 that needs review, real-defect fixes only, and a commit. That work is PDF inline pdf.js canvas rendering, Chilla shortcuts working with a PDF open, Alt/Ctrl+wheel zoom, and the picker supersession fix. PART B: every preview type (Markdown/rendered, source, image, video, PDF) needs an iPhone-like right/middle-button drag pan with momentum fling and a smooth Ctrl/Cmd+wheel (pinch) zoom anchored at the pointer. Both follow the read-only nodetto-cloud reference, and the PART A Alt+wheel zoom is removed.
requiredOutcomes: One shared, unit-tested module src/features/preview/previewPanZoom.ts with nodetto constants PAN_SLOP=4, FLING_WINDOW_MS=80, FLING_DECAY=0.998/ms, FLING_MIN_VELOCITY=0.02, WHEEL_ZOOM_SENSITIVITY=0.0015 and wheelPixels deltaMode normalization. The partial rightDragPan.ts and rightDragPan.vitest.ts are deleted.

Right/middle drag pans Markdown/rendered, source (inner pre owner), image, video and PDF previews with a 4px slop, pointer capture and a grabbing cursor. Release starts a fling from the last 80ms that decays until below 0.02 px/ms or a scroll edge. A new pointerdown, wheel, keydown or document change stops it. prefers-reduced-motion disables it.
contextmenu is suppressed only after a right gesture moved past the slop. A plain right-click still opens it.
The image left-button drag pan (dragPanEnabled) gets the same fling. Text selection and left-click are unchanged.

Ctrl/Cmd+wheel (and pinch) zooms smoothly by Math.exp(-dy*0.0015) about the pointer, within 50-300% (rendered/source/PDF/video) and 50-800% (images). Alt+wheel no longer zooms. Keyboard +/- keeps 10% steps.

PDF wheel zoom resizes the canvas CSS immediately and re-renders once through pdf.js, debounced 150ms, at the final zoom. Page-local anchoring holds (pdfPageAnchorScroll(1200,200,1028,1000,2028,2000) === 2572).
previewZoomDirectionFromWheel is deleted after wave 2. README shortcut lines are updated.
PART A is reviewed with real-defect fixes only. Existing PDF shortcut and picker tests still pass.
bun run typecheck, bun run lint:biome, bun run test and test:dom exit 0 with zero failures. The debug tauri build succeeds.
Everything is committed locally after an accepted integration review.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: A single module, previewPanZoom.ts, pins the contract: wheelPixels, flingVelocity, flingStep, wheelZoomFactor, anchoredZoomScroll, measureAnchor, anchorScrollAfterZoom, applyWheelZoom and attachPreviewPan(target, {isActive, leftButton?, scrollOwner?}) -> {detach, stopFling}.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: This gives identical nodetto semantics across all panes (architecture.md#shared-preview-pan-and-zoom-gestures). The module does not import PreviewPane.tsx, which avoids an import cycle.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: flingStep uses the incoming velocity for displacement, then decays (v * 0.998 ** dt). The fling stops per axis at a scroll edge.
In source layout, the scroll owner is the inner .preview__source-content > .file-preview--text > pre, resolved per call.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The outer .preview--source is overflow hidden, and innerHTML replacement swaps the pre.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: PDF splits zoom into a live zoom and a renderZoom. Wheel zoom resizes canvas CSS and debounces the pdf.js render by 150ms. Anchoring is page-local.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: This avoids a re-render per wheel event and avoids drift from the 12px page gaps (design DR-002).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: previewZoomDirectionFromWheel stays exported during wave 2 and is deleted in finalize. PreviewPane.tsx is written by preview-pan-zoom-preview-pane and then preview-pan-zoom-finalize, serialized through dependsOn.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The media and PDF panes import it until their wave-2 plans remove the import.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Keep the existing App.css .preview--right-drag-panning rule as PREVIEW_PANNING_CLASS.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: No CSS rename is needed, and no plan owns App.css.

intentionalTradeoffs: On macOS WebKit and WebKitGTK, contextmenu fires at press, so right-drag pan may not work in the real app (user-accepted). Middle-button drag stays available.
Per-plan bun run typecheck may fail transiently from a sibling's in-progress wave-2 edits. Only owned-file errors gate a wave-2 plan. The serial finalize gate is authoritative.
The finalize debug build writes dist/ and target/. No accepted plan declares artifactRoots, so none are recorded.
supportedEdgeCases: A move of 4px or less does not scroll and does not suppress contextmenu.
Chord release (right released while left held) ends the gesture without a fling. A following contextmenu is prevented.
pointercancel and lostpointercapture end without a fling. A setPointerCapture failure does not break the gesture.
Hidden panes and audio previews do not pan or zoom.
A paused release (no samples in the last 80ms), reduced motion, or missing matchMedia/requestAnimationFrame means no fling.
A centered video figure or a narrower centered PDF page re-measures its origin after zoom. A pointer in the PDF page gap anchors to the previous page's bottom edge.
A PDF reload or video source change during a fling stops it and clears the PDF debounce timer.
A wheel over the source pre zooms exactly once.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Native video controls intercepting right-button events at runtime (GUI gap).
Real-app macOS/Linux contextmenu ordering (GUI gap delegated to the supervising session).
EPUB, CSV, raw Markdown editor, HTML iframe preview and diff views.
